# What EpiExposure does?

`EpiExposure`...

```{r}
sim_data = readxl::read_xlsx("sim_data.xlsx")

```

```{r}
head(sim_data)
```


```{r}
wetness_plot = sim_data%>% 
  ggplot(aes(time,wetness, group = epi_id))+
  geom_smooth(se = F, color = "#55A868",linewidth = 0.3)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "Days after planting the rice",
       y = "Leaf wetness (%)")+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,85), expand = c(0,0),
                     breaks = pretty(sim_data$time, n = 8))+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10))

wetness_plot
```
```{r}
rain_plot = sim_data%>% 
  ggplot(aes(time,rain, group = epi_id))+

  labs(x = "",
```

```{r}
ggsave("exposure_lag.png", dpi = 600, bg = "white", height = 6, width = 8)
```


```{r}

sim_data2 = sim_data |> 
  filter(epi_id <= 480)

sim_data3 = sim_data |> 
  filter(!epi_id <= 480)

sim_data2$epi_id = as.factor(sim_data2$epi_id)
sim_data3$epi_id = as.factor(sim_data3$epi_id)

### train

cb <- define_exposures(
  data = sim_data2,
  vars = c("wetness","tmean","rain"),
  max_lag = 85,
  df_var = 3,
  df_lag = 2
)

dat <- build_design(
  data = sim_data2,
  cb_templates = cb,
  max_lag = 85
)

dat <- prepare_response(data = dat, response = "y", family = "beta")

fit <- fit_epidlnm(
  data = dat,
  model_engine = "glmmTMB",
  family = "beta",
  random_effect = NULL,
  epiexposure_spec = attr(cb, "spec")
)
summary(fit)

fit$sdr$pdHess
range(dat$y_model)
sum(dat$y_model <= 0)

sum(dat$y_model >= 1)

any(is.na(vcov(fit)$cond))


###  test

cb2 <- define_exposures(
  data = sim_data3,
  vars = c("wetness","tmean","rain"),
  max_lag = 85,
  df_var = 3,
  df_lag = 2
)

dat2 <- build_design(
  data = sim_data3,
  cb_templates = cb,
  max_lag = 85
)

dat2 <- prepare_response(data = dat2, response = "y", family = "beta")


summary(fit)

t = predict(fit, newdata = dat2, type = "response",allow.new.levels=TRUE)


dat3 = dat2
dat3$t = t


dat3 %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y,t))+
  geom_point(color = "#C44E52", size = 2)+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F, color = "#55A868", linewidth = 1.4)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "Observed (proportion)",
       y = "Predicted (proportion)")+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,0.80), expand = c(0.01,0.01))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,0.80), expand = c(0.01,0.01))



```


```{r}
library(DescTools)
CCC(dat3$y, dat3$t, ci = "z-transform", conf.level = 0.95, na.rm = FALSE)
```

```{r}
check_identifiability(data = sim_data, var = "tmean",
                      df_var = 4, df_lag = 2, lag_max = 85)

```

# Effect summarization

## Lag-specific
```{r}
#surface = predict_surface(fit = fit, wx_long = sim_data, var = "tmean", lag_max = 85,
 #                   uncertainty = TRUE, output = "summary", n_samples = 10)

epi_l = summarise_effects(fit = fit, data = sim_data,
                  scale = "daily", effect_measure = "percent",
                  uncertainty = TRUE, n_samples = 20,
                  output = "summary",
                  at = list (
                    tmean = seq(15,35, length.out = 1000),
                    rain = seq(0,15, length.out = 1000),
                    wetness = seq(0,24, length.out = 1000)))

epi_l
```

```{r}
epi_l |> 
  filter(var == "tmean") |> 
  filter(lag == 1) |> 
  ggplot()+
  geom_smooth(aes(value,effect), color = "#4C72B0", se = F)+
  geom_smooth(aes(value,effect_lower), color = "#4C72B0", se = F, linetype = 2)+
  geom_smooth(aes(value,effect_upper), color = "#4C72B0", se = F, linetype = 2)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "Exposure (mm)",
       y = "Effect")
```

```{r}


epi_plot <- epi_l %>%
  filter(var == "tmean")


lims <- quantile(
  epi_plot$effect,
  probs = c(0.02, 0.98),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

max_abs <- max(abs(lims))

epi_plot <- epi_plot %>%
  mutate(
    effect_c = pmax(
      pmin(effect, max_abs),
      -max_abs
    )
  )

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
library(metR)
library(grid)

tmean_contour <- ggplot(
  epi_plot,
  aes(
    x = lag,
    y = value
  )
) +

  geom_raster(
    aes(fill = effect_c),
    interpolate = TRUE
  ) +

  geom_contour(
    aes(z = effect),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.25,
    breaks = c(-15, -10, -5, 0, 5, 10, 15)
  ) +

  geom_text_contour(
    aes(z = effect),
    breaks = 0,
    stroke = 0.15,
    #label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines"),
    size = 3.2
  ) +

  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#3B4CC0", 
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B40426",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-max_abs, max_abs),
    oob = squish,
    name = "Effect (%)",
    guide = guide_colorbar(
      barwidth  = unit(4, "cm"),
      barheight = unit(0.5, "cm")
    )
  ) +

  scale_x_reverse(
    breaks = pretty(epi_plot$lag, n = 8),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = pretty(epi_plot$value, n = 6),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    clip = "off"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Mean temperature (°C)"
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_blank()
  )

tmean_contour
```

```{r}
  mutate(
    period = factor(
      period,
      levels = c("Period4", "Period3", "Period2","Period1")
    ),
    var = factor(
      var,
      levels = c("tmean", "rain", "wetness")
    )
  )

epi_p11 |>
  filter(sample != 10) |>
  ggplot(aes(value, eta, group = sample, color = sample)) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(var ~ period, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black"),
    legend.position = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Exposure",
    y = "Response")
```

# ECI

## Overall

```{r}
ct = compute_eci(
  data = sim_data,
  group = "epi_id",
  group_level = NULL,
  fit = fit,
  var = c("tmean", "rain", "wetness"),
  scale = "response",
  uncertainty = TRUE, n_samples = 10,
                  output = "summary"
)


ctt = ct |> 
  filter(var == "rain")




sim_datact = sim_data |> 
  group_by(epi_id) |> 
  summarise(y = mean(y))


ctt$y = sim_datact$y

cor.test(ctt$ECI_weighted, ctt$y,
         method = "spearman")

ctt |> 
  ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(ECI_weighted,y))+
  geom_smooth(aes(ECI_weighted,y),se = F)+
  geom_smooth(aes(lower,y),se = F)+
  geom_smooth(aes(upper,y),se = F)

ctt2 = ctt |> 
mutate(pressure = case_when(y > 0.24 ~ "High severity",
                           y <= 0.24 ~"Low severity")) 

ctt2 |>
  ggplot(aes(ECI_weighted))+
  geom_histogram(color = "white", fill = "steelblue", bins = 10)+
  facet_wrap(~pressure)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black"))

ctt2 |> 
 # filter(pressure == "High severity") |> 
  ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(ECI_weighted,y))+
  geom_smooth(aes(ECI_weighted,y),se = F)+
  geom_smooth(aes(lower,y),se = F)+
  geom_smooth(aes(upper,y),se = F)+
  facet_wrap(~pressure)

median(ctt$y)
```

## Lag
```{r}
ct2  = compute_ecilag(
  data = sim_data,
  group = "epi_id",
  fit = fit,
  group_level = 1,
  var = c("tmean", "rain","wetness"),
  uncertainty = FALSE,
  n_samples = 10,
 output = "summary")

ct3 = ct2$by_lag

ct3 |> 
  filter(var == "rain") |> 
  ggplot()+
  geom_smooth(aes(exposure,abs_contribution), se = F)+
  geom_smooth(aes(exposure,abs_contribution_upper), se = F, linetype = 2)+
  geom_smooth(aes(exposure,abs_contribution_lower), se = F, linetype = 2)+
  theme_bw()
  
ct_tmean = ct3 %>% 
  filter(var == "rain")

datt = sim_data |> 
  filter(epi_id == 1)

ct_tmean$sev = datt$y


ct_tmean %>% 
  #filter(lag == 85) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(ECI_weighted))+
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, color = "white")




cor.test(ct_tmean$exposure, ct_tmean$percent_contribution,
         method = "spearman")


ct_tmean |> 
  ggplot(aes(exposure,percent_contribution))+
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
range <- simulate_ranges(

  #filter(rain %in% c(5,15)) |>
```

```{r}
)
```

## Ensemble
```{r}
ens_mean <- ensemble_bestfit(
  bestfit = best_models,
  ensemble_scope = "model",
  method = "unweighted",
  model_ids = c(63, 23, 44),
  weight_metric = "CCC",
  hb = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

ens_weighted <- ensemble_bestfit(
  bestfit = best_models,
  ensemble_scope = "model",
  method = "weighted",
  model_ids = c(63, 23, 44),
  weight_metric = "CCC",
  weight_transform = "rank_inverse",
  hb = TRUE
)

ens_stack <- ensemble_bestfit(
  bestfit = best_models,
  ensemble_scope = "model",
  method = "stacked",
  model_ids = c(63, 23, 44),
  stacking_model = "ridge",
  stack_objective = "regularized",
  lambda = 1e-6,
  stack_intercept = TRUE
)

CCC_ensemble = rbind(
  unweighted = ens_mean$ensemble_summary[, c(
    "CCC", "Cb", "rho", "RMSE", "MAE"
  )],
 
  weighted = ens_weighted$ensemble_summary[, c(
    "CCC", "Cb", "rho", "RMSE", "MAE"
  )],
 
  stacked = ens_stack$ensemble_summary[, c(
    "CCC", "Cb", "rho", "RMSE", "MAE"
  )]
)

CCC_ensemble$method = c("unweighted","weighted","stacked")
```


```{r}

ens_mean$ensemble_predictions$method = "unweighted"
ens_weighted$ensemble_predictions$method = "weighted"
ens_stack$ensemble_predictions$method = "stacked"

ensemble_all = rbind(ens_mean$ensemble_predictions,ens_weighted$ensemble_predictions, ens_stack$ensemble_predictions)


```

```{r}

ordem_methods <- c(
  "unweighted",
  "weighted",
  "stacked"
)

ensemble_plot <- ensemble_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(method)) %>%
  mutate(
    method = as.character(method)
  ) %>%
  filter(method %in% ordem_methods) %>%
  mutate(
    method = factor(
      method,
      levels = ordem_methods
    )
  )



CCC_plot <- CCC_ensemble %>%
  mutate(
    method = factor(
      method,
      levels = ordem_methods
    )
  )



pos_CCC <- ensemble_plot %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  summarise(
    x = min(observed, na.rm = TRUE) +
      0.05 * diff(range(observed, na.rm = TRUE)),
   
    y = max(predicted_ensemble, na.rm = TRUE) -
      0.05 * diff(range(predicted_ensemble, na.rm = TRUE)),
   
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    CCC_plot %>% select(method, CCC),
    by = "method"
  )



 ensemble_gg = ggplot(ensemble_plot,aes(observed*100, predicted_ensemble*100)) +
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm",se = FALSE, color = "orange") +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    color = "red",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(
    data = pos_CCC,
    aes(
      x = 2,
      y = 97,
      label = sprintf("CCC = %.2f", CCC)
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 4) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~method,
    ncol = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
    scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.03)
  ) +
 
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.03)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Observed (%)",
    y = "Predicted (%)") +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10,face = "bold"),legend.position = "none")


 ggsave("ensemble.png", dpi = 600, bg = "white", height = 6, width = 10)
```

```{r}
library(patchwork)

final_plot <- ensemble_gg + best_plot +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "a",
    tag_prefix = "(",
    tag_suffix = ")"
  ) &
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_text(
      size = 12,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.94)
  )

final_plot
```

```{r}
range_rain = simulate_ranges(
     periods = period,
     vary = list(
       tmean = 25,
       rain  = seq(0,15, by = 0.5),
       wetness = 10
     ),
     scenario_type = "grid",
     scenario_var = "rain"
)

range_tmean = simulate_ranges(
     periods = period,
     vary = list(
       rain = 5,
       tmean  = seq(18,34, by = 0.5),
       wetness = 2
     ),
     scenario_type = "grid",
     scenario_var = "tmean"
)


range_wetness = simulate_ranges(
     periods = period,
     vary = list(
       rain = 5,
       wetness  = seq(0,24, by = 0.5),
       tmean = 25
     ),
     scenario_type = "grid",
     scenario_var = "wetness"
)

pred_rain = simulate_scenarios(
  fit = fit,
  data = sim_data,
  scenarios = range_tmean,
  uncertainty = TRUE,
  output = "summary",
  n_samples = 20
)

curve_rain = pred_rain |> 
    #group_by(sample) |> 
  transmute(
    value = tmean,
    prediction = prediction*100,
    lower = lower*100,
    upper = upper*100
  ) |>
  arrange(value)

epi_l

sens_p = epi_p |> 
  filter(var == "tmean") |> 
  filter(sample == 1)


sens_rain = df_sensitivity(
  data = curve_rain,
  x = "value",
  y = "prediction",
  scenario_var = NULL,
  elasticity = TRUE,
  critical = TRUE,
  k = 3)

sens_rain |> 
  ggplot(aes(value, elasticity, group = sample))+
  geom_smooth(se = F, color = "black")+
  theme_bw()


sens_rain |> 
  ggplot()+
  geom_smooth(aes(value, prediction),se = F, color = "black")+
  geom_smooth(aes(value, lower),se = F,
              color = "black", linetype = "dashed")+
  geom_smooth(aes(value, upper),se = F,
              color = "black", linetype = "dashed")+
  theme_bw()


sens_rain |> 
  ggplot(aes(value,sensitivity))+
  geom_smooth(se = F)

unique(epi_p$period)
```

# Simulate losses

```{r}

range_losses <- simulate_ranges(
  periods = period,
  vary = list(
    tmean = c(20,34),
    rain = seq(0,15, by = 1),
    wetness = c(2,10)
  ),
  scenario_type = "grid",
  scenario_var = "rain"
)


scenarios_losses = simulate_scenarios(
  fit = fit,
  scenarios = range_losses,
  data = sim_data,
  uncertainty = TRUE,
  output = "summary",
  n_samples = 20,
  seed = 123)

scenarios_losses$prediction = scenarios_losses$prediction*100
scenarios_losses$lower = scenarios_losses$lower*100
scenarios_losses$upper = scenarios_losses$upper*100
```

```{r}
losses = simulate_losses(
             data = scenarios_losses,
             y = "prediction",
             slope = 49.3,
             intercept = 9691.0,
             attainable_yield = seq(4000,12000, by = 50),
             price = 300
)

losses
```


```{r}
yld_losses = losses %>%
```
